question: Who released a special stamp entitled ‘Wheat Revolution’ in July 1968?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Wheat Revolution stamp

 
 
• **In the year 1968, **as a result of the green revolution, wheat production in the **country rose to 17 million tons from 12 million tons during the previous period.**
 
• To signify the achievements of the green revolution, then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi released a special stamp titled 'Wheat Revolution' in July 1968.
 
• The Yellow Revolution is concerned with oilseed production.
 
• This revolution means the cultivation of mustard as a part of crop rotation.
 
• The Father of the Yellow Revolution is Sam Pit Roda.
 
• It was also called People Power Revolution.
 
• It was first launched in 1986-87 in India.
 
• To popularize the four major oilseeds- groundnut, mustard, soybean, and sunflower.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Green Revolution

 
 
• The Green Revolution is referred to as the process of increasing agricultural production (especially wheat and rice) through the introduction of modern tools and technology. 
 
• The green revolution marks the period when the agricultural sector of the country was transformed into a commercial sector with the adoption of modern methods and techniques like the use of a high-yielding variety of seeds, machinery, irrigation facilities, pesticides, and fertilizers.
